risk_note: F1-08ba (orchestrator D10-1517 batch 1 ②; landed per D10-1772). Read-only payout tabs on the admin withdrawals page: the queue overview card (adminGetPayoutOverview), the payout queue table (listAdminWithdrawals), the result-unknown table (adminListUnknownPayouts) and a per-withdrawal payout attempt drawer. No write entry at all (kill switch, retry and manual verdict belong to F1-08bb / bc / bd); a result-unknown payout is only shown, never re-sent (BR-WDR-14). Amounts only through @couli/money. Codex is out of quota until 2026-11-20 (D10-1604), so per ops/approvals.yaml #36 the rule tests were written by an independent Claude (claude-run.sh, fresh context; ledger tester claude-independent): 25 tests; another independent Claude spec-test r1 pass with one S2. Implementation by Opus 5.5 (another context); couli-ci verify:fast run 1 green and --browser run 1 green before rebase. Written by hand.
